author: SickProdigy
description: Monitor named Minecraft Java and Bedrock servers with safe status checks and transition announcements.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild-owned public Minecraft connection settings, bounded cached status data, visibility settings, and announcement configuration. It does not store linked game identities or administrative credentials.
install_msg: Add a server with `[p]minecraftset add <name> <java|bedrock> <host> [port]`. Java uses SRV discovery when the port is omitted; Bedrock defaults to 19132. Private/LAN destinations require exact bot-owner approval.
short: Minecraft Java and Bedrock server status
